links.outcome: LLM performance on real-world perinatal medication consultation questions, rated by pharmacologists
links.effect: Significant overall differences among models (p<0.001); GPT-5.1 highest total score (9.1 ± 0.8), accuracy 9.2 ± 0.7; gaps larger in complex scenarios with comorbidities or benefit–risk trade-offs.
links.quote: Performance gaps were more pronounced in complex clinical scenarios involving comorbidities or benefit–risk trade-offs, whereas domestic models demonstrated relative advantages in consultations involving traditional Chinese medicine.

screen.reason: Evaluates multiple LLMs on a retrospective standardized test set derived from real-world perinatal medication consultation queries without testing a specific organizational safeguard or deployment practice.
